text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: '4.3'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          packages: lintr, styler
          needs: dev
          cache: true

      - name: Create .lintr
        run: |
          cat <<EOF > .lintr
          linters:
            indentation_linter: indentation_linter(2)
            tab_linter: tab_linter()
          EOF

      - name: Run lintr
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_package()'

      - name: Run styler
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'styler::style_pkg()'

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
```
